iPhone 18 Pro 同 iPhone Fold still have a few weeks before their unveiling, and Apple's behind-the-scenes preparations are in full swing. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple held a lottery for its US retail employees, selecting some staff to travel to California to help prepare for the iPhone launch event in September.

iPhone 發布會將於9月舉行。

The report stated that Apple Store retail employees can apply to participate in the iPhone launch event work, including "helping maintain queue order, registering guests, welcoming attendees, giving directions, and supporting the security team."

Apple announced the lottery arrangement in an internal memo today, stating that the event will be held in early September.

The memo mentioned that Apple is "delighted to offer US store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience." Apple has long relied on retail staff to help coordinate large product launch events. According to the memo, employees who participated in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) or last year's iPhone launch event are not eligible for this programme. Interested employees must submit their applications by August 8, and Apple will notify selected employees by August 17.

Apple typically holds its annual iPhone launch event in the second week of September each year. This year, US Labour Day falls on September 7. Bloomberg noted that "the event is more likely to be held on a Wednesday, as this preserves Apple's traditional weekday travel time for attendees."

If so, the iPhone launch event will be held on Wednesday, September 9, with pre-orders expected to open that Friday and the product officially going on sale one week later.
